## Before production use

- **POST-only.** This workflow does NOT implement Meta's required GET verification handshake or X-Hub-Signature-256 signature validation. Do not point Meta's webhook configuration directly at this URL as-is.
- **Testing:** exercise this webhook with any synthetic HTTP client (curl, Postman, etc.) sending POST requests with test payloads.
- **Direct Meta integration** requires adding a separate GET verification endpoint and POST signature validation before this is publicly exposed.
- Classification is deterministic word/phrase matching, not AI/ML. Adapt keywords and languages to your business.
- This workflow never sends a message and never stores data -- it only returns a routing decision.
